page.title: Account
page.purpose: Show account and subscription state without making sign-in a prerequisite for the local-first workspace.

priorities.statement: The account surface makes signed-out, connected, and degraded states explicit.
Local workspace capability remains visible and available without an account.
Provider credentials and account state remain separate concepts.

states.description: No Vrooli account is configured; local access remains available.
Account identity and current plan information are available.
Account or subscription data is unavailable and the reason is visible.

elements.description: Current plan or unavailable account state.

claims.statement: The account surface is inspectable in every account state.
The current account or plan state is visible without requiring provider credentials.
